title: U.S. Marines Refine Shooting Skills
description:
U.S. Marines with the 15th Marine Expeditionary Unit’s Maritime Raid Force fire both rifles and pistols on the flight deck of the USS Anchorage (LPD 23). The 15th MEU, embarked on the ships of the Essex Amphibious Ready Group, is deployed to maintain regional security in the U.S. 5th Fleet area of operations. (U.S. Marine Corps motion media by Sgt. Steve H. Lopez/Released) 
Interview: 
Cpl. James A. Berry (Cypress, TX), Scout with 15th Marine Expeditionary Unit’s Force Recon Det 

Videographer 
Sgt. Steve H. Lopez
